emails.htmlBody:
Hitachi Vantara

Share these new resources with your IBM Z customers

Hi ,

Many of your IBM Z customers are facing storage refresh deadlines. Now is the ideal time to help them step back and evaluate their options, not just renew what’s in place. To make it easier to start mainframe modernization discussions, we’ve put together the following new resources:

New blog: What IT Buyers Need to Know Before a Mainframe Refresh gives you a ready-made framework for conversations.

It covers:

  • How to read performance and availability claims in context.
  • The difference between design targets and contractual guarantees.
  • Sizing effective capacity from real mainframe data.
  • Planning for AI and analytics access without moving data.
  • Nine questions customers should ask every vendor.

How to use it:

  • Share it with customers approaching a lifecycle or lease date.
  • Use the nine questions to structure discovery calls.
  • Loop in your Hitachi Vantara partner manager to plan next steps together.

New eBook: Proof Beats Promises: A Mainframe Storage Buyer's Guide

Changing storage does not mean changing IBM Z or rewriting applications. It means helping your customers decide which parts of their environments should stay stable and which parts can improve.

New Customer Engagement Site

Explore how VSP One for Mainframe can support the next phase of your costumers’ mission-critical infrastructure investments. Includes links to leverage competitive comparisons, customer guarantees, customer stories, analyst reports and more.

New Quick Start Guide and Handbook

Discover how Mainframe Cyber Resiliency v4.1 expands customer choice and control.

  • Improved cyber resilience and operational governance.
  • Extended protection to newer VSP platforms.
  • Support for larger and more demanding enterprise environments.
  • Increased deployment flexibility through standardized reference architectures.

New On-Demand Webinar: Your Next Mainframe Migration Starts Before the Deadline

Explore how to reduce migration risk, safeguard business continuity, and create a long-term roadmap that goes beyond a single infrastructure refresh. Gain actionable insights, proven best practices, and practical guidance to support a successful transition while keeping mission-critical workloads running smoothly.

Additional Partner Resources and Links

  • Top 10 Reasons: VSP One for Mainframe Storage
  • VSP One Block for Mainframe Solution Brief
  • VSP One Block High End
  • VSP One Block High End Resources on the Partner Connect Portal

Drive More Revenue, Sooner, with the VSP One Block for Mainframe Campaign

The VSP One Block for Mainframe campaign is flush with social posts, assets and additional resources to help you generate demand, build pipeline and accelerate VSP One Block for mainframe sales.

Have more questions? Please don’t hesitate to reach out to me.

Thanks,
[PAM Name]

Hitachi Vantara
